isolation_attestation.statement: Review used only the frozen public target, candidate manifest, submitted candidate harnesses, and reviewer-created files under review-output. No Git history, sealed or reveal paths, other reviewer workspaces, issue trackers, parent artifacts, rejected-lead narratives, generator material, network sources, or human assistance were consulted.

ordinary_suite_attestation.notes: Ganache emitted its expected native uWS compatibility warning and used the NodeJS fallback; the suite itself passed.

candidates.title: Borrow callback reentrancy finalizes debt after value transfer

commands.relevant_test: C-001 discriminant: stale-debt callback can repeat beyond two frames

negative_control_result.description: With empty callback data, one 750e18 borrow produced exactly 750e18 debt and 750e18 stable, with no excess debt.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: LendingMarket.borrow checks debt, transfers stable, and invokes the receiver before incrementing debt. A callback can reenter while every frame observes the old debt, and no reentrancy guard blocks it.

items: Ordinary user deploys a callback receiver
Receiver is credited with legitimate collateral
Market has stable liquidity
Outer and recursive calls use nonempty callback data as needed
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The attacker must choose a recursion depth that does not exceed available market liquidity or gas.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: The submitted two-frame transaction produced debt and stable equal to twice the borrow limit. The independent eight-frame check produced 6,000e18 debt/stable from a 750e18 limit.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Submitted run: 1,500e18 debt and stable against a 750e18 limit. Independent run: 6,000e18 debt and stable against the same limit.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Collateral acquisition and initial funding are legitimate setup; the excess extraction arises only from callback ordering.

scope_decision.rationale: An untrusted protocol-user contract exploits an audited production execution path without relying on administrator misconduct or mock-only controls.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The flaw permits direct, repeatable over-borrowing far beyond collateral limits and can scale to available market liquidity in one transaction, causing immediate insolvency.

candidates.notes: Independent recursion-depth evidence strengthens the submitted impact-scaling claim.

candidates.title: Bridge credit does not authenticate remote application sender

negative_control_result.description: A comparator that requires the messenger-reported source sender to equal remoteGateway[sourceChain] rejected the mismatched sender, left credit at zero, and accepted the configured sender.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: BridgeGateway checks the messenger and source chain and checks only that some remote is configured. It reads xDomainMessageSender solely for the event and never authenticates it against remoteGateway.

items: An untrusted application can originate a message on a configured source chain
The trusted messenger truthfully reports that application's mismatching source address
The gateway is configured as the market bridge
The market has stable liquidity
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The finding does not require compromise or false context from the messenger.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: A relay with the correct source chain but an unconfigured source sender credited 1,000e18 bridge collateral, after which the beneficiary borrowed 750e18 stable.

demonstrated_impact.observed: A mismatching remote application obtained 1,000e18 spendable bridge collateral and 750e18 stable without any local collateral deposit.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: The unbacked nature follows from the threat-model premise that an untrusted remote application need not lock assets before originating its message.

scope_decision.rationale: Remote applications are expressly untrusted, while an honest messenger reporting authentic context is within the benchmark assumptions.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: Any untrusted remote application on a configured chain can create arbitrary collateral credit and directly drain market liquidity without backing.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-007: this is sender authentication, not replay-key namespacing.

candidates.title: Permit relayer can redirect signed transfer

negative_control_result.description: Changing the signed amount by one wei invalidated recovery; the transfer and nonce increment both rolled back.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: recipient is a transferFrom destination but is absent from TRANSFER_TYPEHASH and the hashed payload, so signature validity is invariant under recipient substitution.

items: Owner has approved the router for the amount
Relayer possesses a valid owner signature for the prescribed payload
Owner intended a fixed recipient
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: Recipient intent is necessarily out-of-band because the contract's signed format cannot express it.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: The relayer replaced the intended recipient with its own address; recovery succeeded, 25e18 transferred to the relayer, and the intended recipient received zero.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Direct theft of the full 25e18 signed and approved amount, plus consumption of the owner's nonce.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Loss is limited to amounts that the owner both approved and signed.

scope_decision.rationale: A permissionless relayer changes security-relevant calldata that a signed transfer instruction fails to bind.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The issue enables direct token theft of the entire authorized amount whenever a fixed-recipient permit is relayed.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-010: binding recipient does not add verifier-instance or chain domain separation, and vice versa.

candidates.title: ECDSA malleability bypasses reward replay protection

negative_control_result.description: An identical second signature encoding reverted and left total payout at the single authorized 20e18 amount.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: SignatureCodec accepts both low-s and high-s encodings that recover the same signer, while RewardsDistributor keys replay state by keccak256 of the raw signature bytes rather than the claim payload.

items: One legitimate authority-signed claim is available
Distributor holds at least twice the claim amount
Claimant or relayer can transform public signature values
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: A single ECDSA authorization has two relevant (s,v) encodings, so the demonstrated amplification is twofold per authorization.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: Canonical (r,s,v) and transformed (r,n-s,flipped-v) signatures for the same payload had distinct byte hashes, both recovered the authority, and both passed replay checks.

demonstrated_impact.observed: One 20e18 claim authorization paid 40e18; both distinct signature IDs were marked used.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Extra loss is bounded to one additional payout per valid authorization, subject to distributor balance.

scope_decision.rationale: The attack uses only a public valid signature and on-chain verifier/replay logic; no authority compromise is required.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The flaw causes direct unauthorized reward payouts and can materially drain the distributor across legitimate claims.

candidates.notes: Both canonicality enforcement and payload-identity replay protection are relevant remediation layers.

candidates.title: StrategyModule can be reinitialized and seized

commands.relevant_test: C-005 discriminant: reinitialization also grants the arbitrary-call vault role

negative_control_result.description: Without role overwrite, the untrusted caller could neither sweep nor execute and module funds remained intact.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: initialize is externally callable, has no authorized caller requirement, and never checks initialized before overwriting vault and operator.

items: A deployed module has been honestly initialized
The module holds assets or its vault/operator authorities control integrations
Any untrusted account can submit a transaction
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: Concrete loss scales with assets and privileges held by the module.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: An arbitrary account replaced both roles and swept the entire 10e18 balance. The independent check also used the seized vault role to execute a token transfer from the module.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Complete module role takeover, full held-token loss, and acquisition of arbitrary-call authority.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: The run demonstrates the module's own assets and call capability; downstream integration value is deployment-dependent.

scope_decision.rationale: An untrusted EOA exploits the production initializer lifecycle; no trusted-role misconduct is involved.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: Permissionless role seizure gives an attacker immediate control over all module-held assets and its unrestricted external-call authority.

candidates.notes: The initialized flag is set but never enforced.

candidates.title: Any user can raise the global collateral factor

commands.relevant_test: C-006 discriminant: parameter bypass raises risk but remains nominally collateralized at the static price

negative_control_result.description: The same non-guardian caller was rejected when setting a lower factor, leaving the factor at 7,500 bps.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: The non-guardian branch reverts only when nextFactorBps is less than or equal to the current factor, thereby permissionlessly authorizing every increase up to 9,500 bps.

items: Current factor is below 9,500 bps
Attacker can call the public setter
Borrowing impact requires collateral and market liquidity
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The guardian can later restore the parameter; the hard cap remains 9,500 bps.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: A non-guardian changed the factor from 7,500 to 9,500 bps and borrowed 949e18 against collateral whose original limit was 750e18.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Unauthorized global risk-limit increase and 199e18 borrowing above the guardian-configured limit.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: The independent check confirmed that 949e18 debt remained below the static 1,000e18 collateral value; immediate bad debt or profit is not demonstrated without a roughly 5.1% adverse price move or another loss mechanism.

scope_decision.rationale: An ordinary protocol user bypasses access control over a documented guardian risk parameter.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The bypass materially weakens a global solvency buffer and makes bad debt possible after a small price decline, but the demonstrated 95% LTV remains nominally overcollateralized at the unchanged fair price and does not itself yield immediate theft.

candidates.notes: Severity is reduced from the submission's unreviewed High because the reproduction establishes risk-control bypass, not immediate insolvency.

candidates.title: Bridge replay nonce is global across source chains

negative_control_result.description: A comparator keyed by sourceChain and nonce accepted nonce 7 independently from chains 10 and 20 and credited both beneficiaries.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: processedNonce is keyed only by uint64 nonce even though remote gateways are configured per source chain, so independent domains share one replay namespace.

items: At least two configured source chains have independent nonce streams
The streams reuse a nonce
A valid message on one chain is relayed first
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The frozen target does not define remote-gateway nonce allocation or recovery behavior; controllable ordering and upstream locking are deployment assumptions.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: Correct chain/sender contexts for configured chains 10 and 20 both used nonce 7. The first message credited 1e18; the second reverted as PROCESSED and credited zero.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Denial of bridge credit for a later otherwise-valid message from a different configured source chain.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Permanent stranding of source-side collateral is plausible but not directly demonstrated because remote locking and retry semantics are absent from the frozen target.

scope_decision.rationale: The collision occurs in audited gateway state under honest messenger context and independent configured source domains.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The flaw can block valid cross-chain credit and potentially strand funds across domains, but the submitted target directly proves denial of credit rather than theft, and remote recovery semantics are unavailable.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-002 because adding sender authentication alone does not fix cross-chain nonce collisions.

candidates.title: Manipulable reserve spot price is trusted during feed fallback

negative_control_result.description: With a positive one-dollar primary feed, identical pool manipulation left the oracle at one dollar and a 10,000e18 borrow reverted with debt remaining zero.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: On any nonpositive feed answer the oracle immediately consumes ReservePool's current reserve ratio, which a permissionless same-block swap can move without TWAP, delay, or deviation limits.

items: Primary feed returns a nonpositive answer
Reserve pool and lending market have liquidity
Attacker can fund a swap comparable to pool depth
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The feed-failure condition is not attacker-controlled in the reproduction; capital requirements and pool fees reduce feasibility.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: A 10,000e18 quote swap moved the 10,000/10,000 pool spot to about 3.994, the acquired asset was vaulted and collateralized, and the resulting full manipulated limit was borrowed.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Attacker spent 10,000e18 stable, acquired about 4,992.49 asset, then borrowed about 14,955e18 stable; the one-dollar safe limit was only about 3,744.37e18.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: The conditional environment and capital requirement keep the issue below Critical, but the run demonstrates positive net stable extraction and large bad debt if the collateral is forfeited.

scope_decision.rationale: Feed failure is a legitimate operating condition, and pool swaps, vault deposits, and borrowing are permissionless production paths.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: During feed failure an ordinary capitalized user can manipulate the fallback within one transaction and create profitable, materially undercollateralized debt.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-009: this concerns manipulation of the fallback source, not freshness validation of the primary source.

candidates.title: Positive primary price is accepted indefinitely

negative_control_result.description: A comparator with a one-day freshness bound rejected the year-old round, used the one-dollar pool fallback, and rejected the same 1,500e18 borrow.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: ReserveOracle ignores updatedAt, roundId, and answeredInRound and treats every positive answer as valid without any configurable or fixed maximum age.

items: The last positive feed answer becomes stale and exceeds current fair value
An ordinary borrower has collateral
The market has stable liquidity
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The attacker does not control the configured feed; exploitation is conditional on an honest update outage or stalled round.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: After 31,536,001 seconds, the two-dollar positive round remained authoritative while the fallback pool price was one dollar, and the market lent 1,500e18 against 1,000 assets.

demonstrated_impact.observed: Debt reached 1,500e18 although the contemporaneous one-dollar fallback valuation would permit only 750e18.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Actual profit or loss depends on the stale price being above real realizable collateral value; the harness represents that current value with the pool's one-dollar state.

scope_decision.rationale: Time passing and an honest feed outage are operating conditions, not malicious administrator action or mock-control exploitation.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: A materially stale overvaluation can be exploited by an ordinary borrower for immediate excess lending and bad debt, although it depends on feed outage and price divergence.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-008 because a TWAP fallback does not make stale positive primary rounds expire.

candidates.title: Permit signature replays across router instances

negative_control_result.description: A comparator binding router address and chain ID accepted the signature on router A, rejected it on router B, left B's nonce at zero, and transferred only once.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: The payload omits address(this) and block.chainid, while every router maintains a separate nonce mapping; identical initial state therefore accepts identical signatures across verifier instances.

items: Owner approved at least two router instances
The owner's nonce is equal on both instances when signing
Relayer has one valid signature and submits it to each
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The reproduced loss requires multiple approvals and matching per-router nonce state.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: The same signature executed on two distinct PermitRouter deployments, each advanced its independent nonce from zero to one, and the recipient received twice the signed amount.

demonstrated_impact.observed: One 25e18 authorization transferred 50e18 across two approved router instances.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: Loss scales with the number of approved, nonce-aligned verifier instances and available owner balance/allowance.

scope_decision.rationale: A permissionless relayer exploits missing signature-domain separation without owner or administrator compromise.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: Under the stated multi-router approval prerequisite, the issue enables direct duplicate transfer of the full signed amount and can repeat across nonce-aligned instances.

candidates.notes: Distinct from C-003 because its required remediation is verifier/chain domain separation rather than recipient binding.

candidates.title: First-share donation can deny vault deposits

negative_control_result.description: With the same one-wei seed but no donation, the victim's 1,000e18 deposit succeeded and minted 1,000e18 shares.

root_cause_assessment.rationale: When supply is one wei, direct asset donation raises managed assets without minting shares. convertToShares rounds a comparable victim deposit down to zero, and deposit reverts on ZERO_SHARES.

items: Vault is empty or can be reached at a tiny share supply
Attacker can order a seed and donation before the victim deposit
Attacker temporarily commits capital comparable to the blocked deposit
attacker_prerequisites.limitations: The attacker must continually win ordering to repeat the denial and bears gas and opportunity cost.

execution_path_assessment.rationale: A one-wei share seed plus a 1,000e18 donation made a 1,000e18 victim deposit preview and mint zero shares, causing a revert; redeeming the seed recovered the full donation.

demonstrated_impact.observed: The victim was denied service but retained all assets; the attacker recovered 1,000e18 plus the one-wei seed with zero token loss.
demonstrated_impact.scope_boundary: No victim asset theft, insolvency, or persistent freeze was shown.

scope_decision.rationale: The attack uses ordinary ERC-20 transfers, vault deposit/redeem functions, and transaction ordering.

adjudicated_severity.rationale: The effect is a repeatable but transient deposit denial with fully recoverable attacker capital, no victim fund loss, and a narrow empty-vault prerequisite.

candidates.notes: The exact-zero rounding boundary is demonstrated.

duplicate_clustering_rationale: No pair has materially identical root cause, demonstrated impact, and required remediation. Pairs sharing a contract or broad theme remain distinct: C-002/C-007 (sender authentication versus nonce namespacing), C-003/C-010 (recipient binding versus verifier/chain domain separation), and C-008/C-009 (fallback manipulation versus primary-feed freshness).

unavailable_metrics.name: review_started_at_utc
unavailable_metrics.reason: A UTC timestamp was not captured before the first read-only inventory command; later timestamps are recorded exactly rather than retroactively estimating one.

unavailable_metrics.name: C-007 source-side locked collateral and retry behavior
unavailable_metrics.reason: Remote gateway and source-side bridge contracts are not present in the frozen public target, so only destination credit denial is directly measured.

reviewer_harness.initial_failure_explanation: The first run intentionally invoked identical calldata before and after changing StrategyModule authorization. Ganache/ethers reused a stale failed gas estimate on the second invocation. The final harness supplied an explicit gas limit after role change; execution succeeded and all assertions passed.
